name: Fight_AccumulateBaseDamage

name: Fight_ResolveDefenderRosReductions
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Resolve the defender-side ROS reduction phase. If defender_resolution_flags does not already bypass both evasion and defense, run evasion reduction first and only run defense reduction if evasion did not fully terminate the ROS path. Otherwise fall back to the critical-override check.

name: Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverrideByActionKind
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Compute the critical threshold from the current action family. Anti-Air vs air and Anti-Sea vs sea use the current ROS reduction scratch directly; skill_id 3 doubles the threshold, skill_id 0 quadruples it, and all other skills scale it by 8 before calling Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverride.

name: Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverride
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Critical override helper. | If the critical threshold beats current total_ros: | - clear ROS reduction scratch | - set defender_resolution_flags bits 0x04 | 0x08 | 0x40 (bypass evasion, bypass defense, critical hit) | - preserve resolved_ros = total_ros | Because the defender reduction path is bypassed, head-redirect logic that normally occurs during defense reduction may also be bypassed.

name: Fight_ApplyEvasionReductionToRos
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply evasion-side ROS reduction. | Formula: | reduction = Fight_GetBaseDefenderRosReduction(defender) |           + defender.effective_legs_evasion |           - (8 unless defense bypass flag already set) | Then try critical override. If no crit override, total_ros = max(0, total_ros - reduction). | If total_ros reaches 0 and the action is not Laser/Beam and the defender lacks the related affinity bypass flag, set ZERO_ROS_TRIGGERED.

name: Fight_ApplyDefenseReductionToRos
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply defense-side ROS reduction unless bypassed. | Formula: | reduction = Fight_GetBaseDefenderRosReduction(defender) |           + defender.effective_legs_defense |           - (8 unless evasion bypass already set) | If no critical override and reduction > 31: | - total_ros = max(0, total_ros - reduction) | - set defender defense-reaction flag | - if defender has only one surviving part, keep that current target | - otherwise retarget to Fight_PickHighestArmorNonHeadPart1Based(defender) | This is the main non-critical path that redirects damage away from the head.
